steps.title: Login to NHIF Employer Portal
steps.title_sw: Ingia kwenye Mfumo wa Mwajiri wa NHIF
steps.instruction: Go to the NHIF online portal and log in with your employer number and PIN
steps.instruction_sw: Nenda kwenye tovuti ya NHIF ya mtandaoni na ingia ukitumia nambari yako ya mwajiri na PIN

steps.title: Go to Member Registration
steps.instruction: On the employer dashboard, click 'Member Management' then select 'Register New Member'
steps.instruction_sw: Kwenye dashibodi ya mwajiri, bonyeza 'Usimamizi wa Wanachama' kisha chagua 'Sajili Mwanachama Mpya'

steps.title: Enter Employee Details
steps.instruction: Fill in the employee's full name, date of birth, National ID number, and employment date
steps.instruction_sw: Jaza jina kamili la mfanyakazi, tarehe ya kuzaliwa, nambari ya Kitambulisho cha Taifa, na tarehe ya kuajiriwa
steps.expected_screen: New member registration form with personal details fields

steps.title: Add Beneficiaries
steps.instruction: Add the employee's dependants (spouse and children under 18). Click 'Add Beneficiary' for each one
steps.instruction_sw: Ongeza wategemezi wa mfanyakazi (mwenzi na watoto walio chini ya miaka 18). Bonyeza 'Ongeza Mtegemezi' kwa kila mmoja
steps.expected_screen: Beneficiary section of the registration form
steps.success_indicator: All beneficiaries added to the form

steps.title: Submit Registration
steps.instruction: Review all the information, then click 'Submit' to register the employee with NHIF
steps.instruction_sw: Kagua taarifa zote, kisha bonyeza 'Tuma' kusajili mfanyakazi na NHIF
steps.expected_screen: Registration summary with all entered details
steps.success_indicator: NHIF membership number generated and shown for the new member
